collect_hybrid.require_roster_actor.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION collect_hybrid.require_roster_actor(p_actor uuid, p_session uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare enabled_flag boolean; begin
 perform collect_hybrid.require_roster_actor_authority(p_actor,p_session,'platform_owner',array['collections.moderate','users.read']);
 select enabled into enabled_flag from public.feature_flags where key='hybrid_member_onboarding' for share;
 if enabled_flag is distinct from true then raise exception 'roster_feature_disabled' using errcode='55000'; end if;
end $function$

public.verify_roster_source_integrity.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verify_roster_source_integrity(p_reservation_id uuid, p_actor_id uuid, p_session_id uuid, p_decoder_receipt_sha256 text, p_decoder_build_sha256 text, p_policy_version text, p_toolchain jsonb, p_summary jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
   begin perform collect_hybrid.guard_roster_service_recovery((select s.id from collect_hybrid.roster_import_sources s join collect_hybrid.roster_resource_reservations r on r.request_id=s.request_id where r.id=p_reservation_id)); return collect_hybrid.verify_roster_source_integrity_guarded_149(p_reservation_id,p_actor_id,p_session_id,p_decoder_receipt_sha256,p_decoder_build_sha256,p_policy_version,p_toolchain,p_summary); end $function$

collect_hybrid.guard_roster_service_reco.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION collect_hybrid.guard_roster_service_recovery(p_import uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
 perform collect_hybrid.roster_recovery_leaf(p_import,true);
 if exists(select 1 from collect_hybrid.roster_recovery_transfers where to_import_id=p_import) then
  raise exception 'roster_recovery_provider_replay_forbidden' using errcode='55000'; end if;
end $function$
